# F009.4 synthetic layout fixture

`f0094-layout-fixture.docx` contains only generated sample text. It has two pages, a heading/title style, a header with an embedded synthetic logo, a page-number footer, bold and italic runs, superscript and subscript runs, an Office Math equation, a bordered table, a numbered-list entry, a page break, and a reference citation. The integration test maps one paragraph on each page and checks that the converted document keeps those elements available in the local PDF conversion.

No user documents, names, or private material are included.
